note: caiso-175 IS THE CAISO TAC LOAD-SERIES INTAKE caiso-173 §C asked for -- and it closed a SECOND defect in the same input that no prior session had seen. Both are rule-14 [R-ACCURATE] demand-input corrections with ZERO free parameters; the DOF ledger is UNCHANGED at n_entries 11 / n_residual 8. (1) MWD-TAC, the Metropolitan Water District metered subsystem, is the SIXTH CAISO-internal area the live OASIS SLD_FCST domain carries, and it was hard-coded out of scripts/data/postprocess_oasis_downloads.CAISO_TACS -- so it never reached the committed series and had no CAISO_TAC_ZONE_WEIGHTS row. Because load_zonal_shares NORMALISES the component TACs to 1.0 this was NOT missing load: MWD's 119.1/171.6/144.1 MW was silently re-apportioned PRO RATA across the other four TACs. It is intaken here and mapped 1:1 onto SP15_rest -- a STRUCTURAL containment, not a fitted split: MWD's CAISO-metered load is the Colorado River Aqueduct pumping chain in eastern Riverside/San Bernardino County, which the CAISO LCT study's own local-area taxonomy carries as Blythe/Parker, DISTINCT from both LA Basin and San Diego/Imperial Valley, and SP15_rest is defined in iso_configs as exactly that SP26 residual. The measured shape CORROBORATES the identification rather than assuming it: hour-of-day CV 0.005 against 0.115-0.128 for the retail TACs (a flat industrial pumping block, not a retail diurnal shape) with a summer/winter ratio of 1.50 (water-delivery seasonality). (2) THE 2023 COVERAGE HOLE, found while performing (1) and NOT previously on the record: the committed CAISO_tac_load_hourly_2023.csv spanned 2023-01-01 to 2023-02-01 ONLY -- 744 of 8,760 hours -- so 91.5 % of a SCORED calibration year ran on a FLAT January-average zonal split with no diurnal and no seasonal shape. The loader had been saying so out loud in every 2023 run ('covers 744/8760 hours; uncovered hours use the sample-average zone shares') and it had never been actioned. Completed here to 8,759 hours. CAISO-173 §C IS CONFIRMED ON DATA, NOT RE-ASSERTED: it predicted the MWD omission misplaced 0.297/0.243 pp of ISO load north of Path 15 in 2024/2025; the realised NP15 share deltas are -0.262/-0.215 pp (its estimate ran ~12 % high because it was computed against the January-window MWD mean). THE 2023 RE-APPORTIONMENT IS FAR LARGER THAN MWD AND IS THE COVERAGE LEG: NP15 -1.123 pp, LA_BASIN +1.239 pp -- the January sample systematically over-weighted the winter-heavy north and under-weighted the summer-peaking LA Basin, all year.
